about.description: Bahama Bob's is a laid-back beachside seafood restaurant located on West Beach in Gulf Shores, Alabama. Born from the adventurous spirit of founder Bob, who survived a hurricane near Rum Cay in the Bahamas and was inspired to bring a slice of island living to the Gulf Coast, Bahama Bob's serves up fresh Gulf seafood, burgers, po'boys, and island-inspired dishes in a friendly, casual atmosphere. The restaurant prides itself on being the place where you find the very best of everything you come to the beach for, all in one place.
about.elevator_pitch: Bahama Bob's is the ultimate beachside escape on the Alabama Gulf Coast, serving fresh Gulf seafood and island-inspired eats with the kind of warm, unforgettable hospitality that keeps guests coming back trip after trip.
about.vibe: Laid-back, island-inspired beachside gem with warm hospitality
about.insider_tip: Don't miss the Alligator Bites or Smoked Tuna Dip as starters, and regulars rave about having the best fries on the beach — crispy and cooked just right.
press: Featured positive reviews praising the Bahama Bob Burger, Seafood Plate, house gumbo, shrimp & scallop skewers, and exceptional service from staff including Kevin and Skyler
